newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close higher as blue chips gain.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close higher as blue chips gain.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher on Wednesday on gains by most blue chips led by engineering and food scrips in an otherwise mixed market, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index rose 9.26 points or 0.43 percent to 2,137.39. Of the 114 issues traded, 60 gained, 48 lost and six remained unchanged.
"Overall market sentiment was mixed. There were buyers and also sellers. All that signals is stability," said one broker.
Bangladesh Tobacco gained 1.64 taka to 314, Shine Pukur Holdings rose 1.44 to 196.43 and Beximco Pharma shed 7.08 to 287.08.
